cards.text: Moses, Israel's leader, and his brother Aaron are about to stand in front of Pharaoh, king of Egypt. Before they walk in, the LORD gives them a heads-up. When Pharaoh tells them, "Perform a miracle," the LORD already has the plan ready.

cards.question: When Pharaoh asks for a miracle, what is Aaron supposed to do with his staff?

answers.text: Strike the palace floor with it
Raise it up toward the sky

cards.question: The LORD says that when Aaron throws his staff down before Pharaoh, it will become a ___.

cards.text: So Moses and Aaron go to Pharaoh and do just what the LORD commanded. Aaron throws his staff down in front of Pharaoh and his officials, and it becomes a serpent. Friend, if a stick did that in MY bakery, I'd be on top of the oven. Base and all. I'm not proud of it.

cards.question: A staff just turned into a serpent right in front of Pharaoh. What does Pharaoh do?

answers.text: Calls his wise men and sorcerers
Sends Moses and Aaron to prison
Orders his guards to kill the serpent

cards.question: Pharaoh's magicians each throw down a staff, and their staffs become serpents too.

cards.text: So now there are serpents ALL over the floor. Aaron's staff against Pharaoh's whole staff. Ha! Staff. I've been saving that one since the drawer, friend. Let me have it.

cards.question: With all those serpents on Pharaoh's floor, what does Aaron's staff do to the magicians' staffs?

answers.text: Chases them out of the palace

cards.question: Even after Aaron's staff wins, Pharaoh's heart was ___, and he would not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the LORD had said.

cards.text: The LORD tells Moses that Pharaoh's heart is unyielding. He refuses to let the people go. That's dough straight out of the fridge, friend. You can push on it ALL day. So the LORD sends Moses back out, first thing in the morning.

cards.question: Where is Moses supposed to wait to meet Pharaoh that morning?

answers.text: On the bank of the Nile
At the edge of the Red Sea

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses to bring along the same staff that was changed into a snake.

cards.text: Moses has a message for Pharaoh from the LORD, the God of the Hebrews: Let My people go. And until now, Pharaoh hasn't listened. But the LORD gives a reason for it.

cards.question: Why does the LORD tell Pharaoh to let His people go?

answers.text: So they may worship Him in the wilderness
So they may build Him a great temple
So they may rest from all their work

cards.text: Then comes the warning: "By this you will know that I am the LORD." Moses will strike the water of the Nile with the staff, and it will turn to blood.

cards.question: Once the Nile turns to blood, the fish in it will ___, the river will stink, and the Egyptians will be unable to ___ its water.

cards.text: Then the LORD makes it bigger. Aaron is to stretch out his staff over ALL the waters of Egypt: the rivers, the canals, the ponds, every reservoir. Not just the Nile. EVERYTHING.

cards.question: The LORD says the blood will stay out in the rivers and ponds and leave the water in the vessels of wood and stone alone.

cards.text: Moses and Aaron do just as the LORD commanded. Right in front of Pharaoh and his officials, Aaron raises the staff and strikes the water of the Nile.

cards.question: When Aaron strikes the Nile, how much of its water turns to blood?

cards.text: The fish die, and the river smells so bad the Egyptians can't drink from it. Blood all through the land. Now listen. I lived in a junk drawer for YEARS. I know musty. This is not musty. This is a whole different department.

cards.question: This time, Egypt's magicians can't do the same thing with their magic arts.

cards.text: So Pharaoh's heart is hardened, and he won't listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the LORD had said. Same as with the serpents.

cards.question: With his whole river turned to blood, what does Pharaoh do next?

answers.text: Goes into his palace without taking it to heart
Begs Moses and Aaron to heal the river right away
Sends all his officials out to clean the Nile

cards.text: Pharaoh's back inside. But out there, the Egyptians still need something to drink. Imagine getting thirsty and the plan involves a SHOVEL.

cards.question: The Egyptians can't drink from the river. So how do they get water?

answers.text: They dig around the Nile for it
They travel to the land of Goshen

cards.question: And ___ full days passed after the LORD had struck the Nile.

cards.text: Seven days. And Pharaoh's still not budging. Pull up a stool, friend. This story is a long way from done.
